description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Myr Battlesphere and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time, as well as two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
The Myr Battlesphere tokens enter the battlefield, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens and eight 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.
